mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follower_fanout_logs (id, post_type, post_id, author_id, status, push_enabled, post_count, follower_total, notified_count, pushed_count, started_at) VALUES (#{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{postType}, #{postId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{authorId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{status}, #{pushEnabled}, #{postCount}, 0, 0, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE follower_fanout_logs SET status = #{status}, error = #{error}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follower_fanout_logs WHERE author_id = #{authorId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND push_enabled = TRUE AND started_at > NOW() - make_interval(mins => #{minutes}))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follower_fanout_logs l WHERE l.author_id = #{authorId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND l.push_enabled = FALSE AND l.status IN ('RUNNING', 'DONE') AND l.started_at > GREATEST( NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(p.started_at) FROM follower_fanout_logs p WHERE p.author_id = l.author_id AND p.push_enabled = TRUE), '-infinity'::timestamp))
